publishedCommit.subject: V3: add roots normalizer CLI and Segment checkpoint adapter
body: Wire the source-only normalizer, CLI and existing Segment adapter.
Fix operation identity and resume ordering, bounded stdout, and physical storage boundary checks.
Expose the checkpoint intention initializer across the backend and CLI module boundary.
Package wiring remains a proposal; no SwiftPM, compiler, test, CLI or runtime execution was performed.
